acceptance: RED first: a registry file with an unknown field fails the reader before the code exists
evolve guidance build is byte-stable: a second run changes nothing
evolve guidance check exits 1 on a stale index, a duplicate statement or L0 over 60 lines or 30 rules. It also exits 1 on two active rules in conflict and on an absent enforced_by path
evolve guidance index --json prints one evolve.guidance.index/1 envelope, and --audience, --phase and --cli filter the rows. An unknown audience or CLI exits 10. A bad registry file exits 11
The 20 L0 rules of plan §9.5 are in guidance/rules/, and the digest of AGENTS.md carries their generated region and the pointer line
The docs give the order: guidance build, skills generate, then guidance check and skills check. CI runs both checks. guidance index --json prints the envelope on a usage exit too
Changed functions at 100% coverage on every CI OS; the package note and the spec are updated
fix: Add go/internal/guidance with a strict reader of guidance/rules/<id>.md that fails closed. Add a build that writes guidance/index.md, guidance/index.json and the GENERATED:guidance-l0 region of the AGENTS.md digest. Add a check for a stale output, a duplicate statement, the L0 budget, conflicts_with, an absent enforced_by path and an L0 rule with families. Add evolve guidance build|check|index with --json and the exit codes of §10.3. Add a CI step and the first L0 batch of plan §9.5.
